goal: Create scripts/bench_model.py, a stdlib-only CLI that runs the existing scripts/bench.py for one Ollama model tag.
requirements: Options: --model TAG (required), --n INT (default 2), --sections LIST (default output,realworld), --gguf PATH (optional), --out-dir NAME (default bench/models).
Set TOKENFRUGAL_MODEL_BUILDER and TOKENFRUGAL_MODEL_THINKER to --model, and BENCH_OUT_DIR to --out-dir, in the child environment.
Run the repo venv's Python on scripts/bench.py --n N --only SECTIONS --tag TAG, with PYTHONPATH and the working directory set to the repo root. Exit with its return code.
With --gguf PATH, write a Modelfile in a temp folder (FROM PATH, PARAMETER num_ctx 16384, PARAMETER temperature 0.1) and run ollama create TAG -f on it, unless ollama list already shows TAG.
Compute the repo root from the script's path. Stream the child's stdout. Give the module a 3-line usage example in its docstring. Do not modify scripts/bench.py.
context: Python 3.11, argparse. The --tag value is the model tag in a folder-safe form. Change no other file.
